Name: Christian Shrine
Author: p0stpwned
Description:
For my complete Christian Conversion Mod, which includes this shrine, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7682/]Christian Conversion Mod[/url].

A very simple mod to change the altar to Yoba in Pierre's shop to a Christian shrine, complete with a cross. Nothing particularly wrong with fictional religions and fully respect Ape's creativity, just thought it would be neat if Pelican Town residents were Christians.

Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.

Considering expanding the mod to include the various other references to Yoba in the game (e.g. "Ring of Yoba") if anybody is interested.

This is my first ever mod so be gentle.

Downloads.Description: Christian Shrine replaces Yoba altar. Unzip to Mods folder.
